**Live data since ${go_live}; earlier history was imported.** Flights and controller sessions from 24-08-2025 to 15-03-2026 come from the previous system (no speed, altitude or SELCAL for imported flights). There is no data from 15-03-2026 to ${go_live}. Panels for the last 7 or 30 days and the live tables show current data only. All times are UTC.

panels.title: Most popular international routes (last 30 days)
panels.description: Most popular routes over the last 30 days with at least one end outside the home region.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT route_label AS route, departure, arrival, count(*) AS flights, count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.departure <> f.arrival
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
  AND NOT (f.dep_is_home AND f.arr_is_home)
GROUP BY route_label, departure, arrival
ORDER BY flights DESC, route
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most popular domestic routes (last 30 days)
panels.description: Most popular routes over the last 30 days with both ends in the home region.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT route_label AS route, departure, arrival, count(*) AS flights, count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.departure <> f.arrival
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
  AND f.dep_is_home AND f.arr_is_home
GROUP BY route_label, departure, arrival
ORDER BY flights DESC, route
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most popular VFR routes (last 30 days)
panels.description: Most popular VFR routes over the last 30 days, flown by at least 3 pilots.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT route_label AS route,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots,
       count(*) AS flights,
       round(avg(duration_minutes)::numeric, 1) AS "Average duration (min)",
       min(end_time) AS "First flight",
       max(end_time) AS "Latest flight"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.flight_rules = 'V'
  AND f.departure <> f.arrival
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
GROUP BY route_label
HAVING count(DISTINCT cid) >= 3
ORDER BY pilots DESC, flights DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Pilots with the most diverse routes (last 14 days)
panels.description: Pilots who flew the most distinct routes over the last 14 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (array_agg(f.name ORDER BY f.end_time DESC))[1] AS pilot,
       count(DISTINCT route_label) AS unique_routes,
       count(*) AS total_flights
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.duration_minutes > 60
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
GROUP BY f.cid
ORDER BY unique_routes DESC, total_flights DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Busiest home-region airports (last 30 days)
panels.description: Busiest home-region airports by departures and arrivals over the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT airport,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE movement_type = 'departure') AS departures,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE movement_type = 'arrival') AS arrivals
FROM movements
WHERE movement_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY airport
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, airport
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Quietest home-region airports (last 30 days)
panels.description: Quietest home-region airports by departures and arrivals over the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT airport,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE movement_type = 'departure') AS departures,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE movement_type = 'arrival') AS arrivals,
       count(*) AS total_movements
FROM movements
WHERE movement_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY airport
ORDER BY total_movements, airport
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Most popular airlines (last 30 days)
panels.description: Most popular airlines by flights over the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(airline_name, airline_prefix) AS airline,
       count(*) AS flights,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND airline_prefix IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY airline_prefix, airline_name
ORDER BY flights DESC, pilots DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most popular callsigns (last 30 days)
panels.description: Most popular callsigns and routes flown by at least 2 pilots over the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT callsign, departure, arrival,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS unique_pilots,
       count(*) AS total_flights
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY callsign, departure, arrival
HAVING count(DISTINCT cid) >= 2
ORDER BY unique_pilots DESC, total_flights DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most popular aircraft by flights (last 6 months)
panels.description: Flights per aircraft category over the last 6 months.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(aircraft_category, 'Other / uncategorised') AS category,
       count(*) AS flights,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.aircraft_icao IS NOT NULL AND f.aircraft_icao <> ''
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY flights DESC

panels.title: Most popular aircraft by pilots (last 6 months)
panels.description: Pilots per aircraft category over the last 6 months.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(aircraft_category, 'Other / uncategorised') AS category,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.aircraft_icao IS NOT NULL AND f.aircraft_icao <> ''
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY pilots DESC

panels.title: Highest groundspeeds (last 7 days)
panels.description: Highest peak groundspeeds per callsign over the last 7 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT callsign, pilot, aircraft_icao AS aircraft, departure, arrival,
       max_gs_kt AS "Peak groundspeed (kt)", max_alt_ft AS "Highest altitude (ft)", end_time AS "Flight ended"
FROM (
  SELECT f.callsign, f.name AS pilot, f.aircraft_icao, f.departure, f.arrival, f.max_gs_kt, f.max_alt_ft, f.end_time,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY f.callsign ORDER BY f.max_gs_kt DESC, f.end_time DESC) AS rn
  FROM flight_ext f
  WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND f.max_gs_kt > 100 AND f.max_gs_kt <= 750
    AND f.max_alt_ft > 1000
    AND f.arrival IS NOT NULL AND f.arrival <> ''
    AND f.aircraft_icao IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT f.is_military
    AND COALESCE(f.aircraft_category, '') NOT IN ('Supersonic', 'Business jet', 'Turboprop')
    AND f.aircraft_icao <> ALL (ARRAY['E135', 'E145', 'E170', 'E175', 'E190', 'E195',
         'F18H', 'VF35', 'BE90', 'GLF7', 'FAL7', 'FAL8', 'FAL9', 'FAL0',
         'AT42', 'DH8Q', 'PC21', 'EMB1', 'EMB2', 'EMB3', 'EMB4', 'EMB5'])
    AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'MIG%' AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'MIR%'
    AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'F-%' AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'SU-%' AND f.aircraft_icao NOT LIKE 'TU-%'
) ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY max_gs_kt DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Busiest days by flights (last 6 months)
panels.description: The five days with the most flights over the last 6 months (UTC).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (f.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS flight_date,
       trim(to_char(f.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'Day')) AS day_name,
       count(*) AS total_flights
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.start_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY total_flights DESC, flight_date DESC
LIMIT 5

panels.title: Busiest days by pilots online (last 6 months)
panels.description: The ten days with the most pilots online over the last 6 months (UTC).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS member_date,
       trim(to_char(f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'Day')) AS day_name,
       count(DISTINCT f.cid) AS unique_pilots,
       row_number() OVER (ORDER BY count(DISTINCT f.cid) DESC, (f.logon_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date DESC) AS rank
FROM flight f
WHERE f.logon_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY unique_pilots DESC, member_date DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Flights with SELCAL in the remarks
panels.description: Share of flights with SELCAL in the remarks, out of flights that have remarks.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.has_selcal) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS "SELCAL (%)"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.has_remarks

panels.title: Which member spent the most time online? (last 7 days)
panels.description: Australian-based pilots with the most airborne hours over the last 7 days, regardless of the time selector.

targets.rawSql:
WITH flight_summaries AS (
  -- v3 stand-in for the v1 table: one row per flight
  SELECT cid, name, logon_time,
         end_time AS completion_time,
         airborne_minutes AS total_enroute_time_minutes,
         duration_minutes AS time_online_minutes
  FROM flight
)
SELECT
    cid,
    name,
    ROUND(SUM(total_enroute_time_minutes) / 60.0) AS total_enroute_hours
FROM flight_summaries
WHERE
    SUBSTRING(name FROM LENGTH(name) - 3 FOR 1) = 'Y'
    AND total_enroute_time_minutes > 30
    AND completion_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY cid, name
ORDER BY SUM(total_enroute_time_minutes) DESC, cid
LIMIT 10
